verdict.rationale: Vendor docs explicitly state users can ask Copilot in natural language to explain codebases, get insights into public and private repositories, and open PRs, all within GitHub Mobile, plus Copilot code review and PR management features. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration specifically of the conversational Copilot Q&A feature (community evidence is older and about pre-Copilot mobile app issues, not this AI chat capability).
